column1: # Indonesian (id) interface catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   context    empty (Doc4Me uses no contexts yet)
#   source     the English text exactly as in the code (tl!(...), ribbon labels, command labels)
#   escapes    \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns, and a
#              trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Clean room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label in ordinary
# Indonesian computing vocabulary. No Microsoft Word (or other product) localisation, string table or
# translated UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Product, format and technology names (Doc4Me, PDF, Markdown, MCP …) stay in Latin letters.
# Conventions: commands are imperatives (Simpan, Sisipkan), tabs and groups are nouns; Title Case
# for commands and menu labels as in the English source, sentence case for options and messages.
# Machine translation by an AI model (Claude), not yet reviewed by a native speaker.
